recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中圈起第 6、8、19 號各有三條（三體），第 9 對與第 22 號亦被圈起：22 號共三條、其中含縮短的費城染色體，提示除 t(9;22) 外還多一條 Ph；額外 Ph、+8、+19 皆屬 CML 進展期的主要途徑異常。
features: G-banded male karyogram (XY) with a hyperdiploid chromosome count
Three copies each of chromosomes 6, 8, and 19 (circled)
Chromosome 9 pair circled, consistent with involvement in t(9;22)
Three chromosome 22-sized elements circled, consistent with an additional Philadelphia chromosome (+der(22))
Band resolution limits confident distinction of normal 22 from Ph chromosomes; FISH confirmation advised
describe_en: G-banded karyogram shows a male hyperdiploid complement with trisomies of chromosomes 6, 8, and 19, together with t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) and an additional copy of the Philadelphia chromosome, approximating 50,XY,+6,+8,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2),+19,+der(22)t(9;22). An extra Ph, trisomy 8, and trisomy 19 are major-route additional chromosomal abnormalities associated with progression. At this banding resolution, the identity of each chromosome 22 homolog cannot be fully resolved, and BCR::ABL1 FISH is recommended to confirm the number of fusion signals. In a patient with myeloid blast phase CML, this represents clonal evolution.

ddx.dx: CML chronic phase with Ph only
ddx.vs: Shows an isolated t(9;22) without additional chromosomal abnormalities.
Lacks a preceding chronic phase, basophilia, or splenomegaly and less often shows major-route ACAs like +Ph.
Gains typically involve X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, 21 without t(9;22), and blasts are B-lymphoid.
